summary: The step pictures carry most faults: a kaleidoscope dot-grid in the first sky, flat digital fills (snow, post, bracket, lantern) with lumpy outlines, ghosts of the glow before its steps, and big unasked changes or jumps (the snowfield repainted on the peach step, the brass fully modeled in one step, the glass recolored on the bars step). The words mostly match the pictures, but paints go wrong at the ends (white stars named gray, unnamed drift colors on step 7, brown bars named Deep night blue), and some loads and terms are used unexplained.
